# orq_team (Resource)

A workspace team. Members are managed with `orq_team_member` and project access with the `teams` attribute of `orq_project`; this resource never writes either, so they cannot conflict. Deleting a team removes its memberships and project access.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "orq_team" "platform" {
  display_name = "Platform"
  description  = "Owns the shared gateway configuration"
}

# Project access is granted from the project side.
resource "orq_project" "production" {
  name  = "Production"
  teams = [orq_team.platform.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) Human-readable team name (1-150 characters).

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description (at most 500 characters). Removing the attribute keeps the stored value; set it to `""` to clear it.

### Read-Only

- `admin_group` (Boolean) Whether this is the workspace admin team.
- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Team ID (a UUID) assigned by orq.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time (RFC 3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Teams are imported by their id (a UUID).
terraform import orq_team.platform 0b3f2c9e-7a1d-4e5b-9c2a-1f2e3d4c5b6a
```
